base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.description: Enter the base URL. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

flowData.label: Flow Data
flowData.description: The flow graph as a JSON string, e.g. `{"nodes":[],"edges":[]}`. Copy it from Get Chatflow to clone a flow.

type.label: Type
type.description: Kind of flow. Use CHATFLOW for a classic chatflow.

isPublic.label: Public
isPublic.description: Whether the chatflow is publicly accessible without an API key.

flowise_create_lead.label: Create Lead
flowise_create_lead.description: Adds a lead to a chatflow.

chatflowId.label: Chatflow ID
chatflowId.description: ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.

chatId.label: Chat ID
chatId.description: Chat session the lead came from. Flowise generates one when empty.

flowise_create_tool.label: Create Tool
flowise_create_tool.description: Creates a custom tool that flows can call.

name.label: Name
name.description: Tool name the LLM sees, in snake_case, e.g. `get_weather`.

description.label: Description
description.description: What the tool does and when the LLM should call it.

color.label: Color
color.description: Background color of the tool card, e.g. `linear-gradient(rgb(0,0,0), rgb(0,0,0))` or `#4CAF50`.

schema.label: Input Schema
schema.description: JSON string array of input fields, e.g. `[{"id":0,"property":"city","type":"string","description":"City name","required":true}]`.

func.label: Function
func.description: JavaScript the tool runs. Inputs are available as `$<property>`, e.g. `$city`. Must return a string.

value.label: Value
value.description: Value of the variable. Required for runtime variables too, where it is ignored.

type.label: Type
type.description: Static stores the value; runtime reads the server environment variable. Defaults to static.

assistantId.label: Assistant ID
assistantId.description: ID of the assistant, from List Assistants.

isDeleteBoth.label: Delete on OpenAI Too
isDeleteBoth.description: For OPENAI and AZURE assistants: also delete the assistant on OpenAI.

flowise_delete_chat_messages.label: Delete Chat Messages
flowise_delete_chat_messages.description: Deletes the chat messages of a chatflow that match the filters.

chatflowId.label: Chatflow ID
chatflowId.description: ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.

chatId.label: Chat ID
chatId.description: Only delete messages from this chat session.

sessionId.label: Session ID
sessionId.description: Only delete messages with this memory session ID.

chatType.label: Chat Type
chatType.description: INTERNAL = chats from the Flowise UI, EXTERNAL = chats through the API or embed.

startDate.label: Start Date
startDate.description: Only include records created on or after this date (ISO 8601).

endDate.label: End Date
endDate.description: Only include records created on or before this date (ISO 8601).

hardDelete.label: Hard Delete
hardDelete.description: Also delete the messages from the memory node of the flow.

chatflowId.label: Chatflow ID
chatflowId.description: ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.

flowise_delete_document_chunk.label: Delete Document Chunk
flowise_delete_document_chunk.description: Permanently deletes one chunk from a document loader.

storeId.label: Document Store ID
storeId.description: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.

loaderId.label: Loader ID
loaderId.description: ID of a document loader inside the store, from the `loaders` array of Get Document Store.

chunkId.label: Chunk ID
chunkId.description: ID of the chunk, from Get Document Chunks.

flowise_delete_document_loader.label: Delete Document Loader
flowise_delete_document_loader.description: Permanently deletes a document loader and its chunks.

storeId.label: Document Store ID
storeId.description: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.

loaderId.label: Loader ID
loaderId.description: ID of a document loader inside the store, from the `loaders` array of Get Document Store.

storeId.label: Document Store ID
storeId.description: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.

toolId.label: Tool ID
toolId.description: ID of the tool, from List Tools.

variableId.label: Variable ID
variableId.description: ID of the variable, from List Variables.

flowise_delete_vector_store_data.label: Delete Vector Store Data
flowise_delete_vector_store_data.description: Deletes the data a document store upserted into its vector store.

storeId.label: Document Store ID
storeId.description: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.

assistantId.label: Assistant ID
assistantId.description: ID of the assistant, from List Assistants.

chatflowId.label: Chatflow ID
chatflowId.description: ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.

flowise_get_document_chunks.label: Get Document Chunks
flowise_get_document_chunks.description: Gets one page of the chunks of a document loader.

storeId.label: Document Store ID
storeId.description: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.

loaderId.label: Loader ID
loaderId.description: ID of a document loader inside the store, from the `loaders` array of Get Document Store.

pageNo.label: Page
pageNo.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

flowise_get_document_store.label: Get Document Store
flowise_get_document_store.description: Gets one document store by ID.

storeId.label: Document Store ID
storeId.description: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.

flowise_get_tool.label: Get Tool
flowise_get_tool.description: Gets one custom tool by ID.

toolId.label: Tool ID
toolId.description: ID of the tool, from List Tools.

flowise_query_document_store.label: Query Document Store
flowise_query_document_store.description: Runs a retrieval query against a document store.

storeId.label: Document Store ID
storeId.description: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.

flowise_refresh_document_store.label: Refresh Document Store
flowise_refresh_document_store.description: Re-processes and re-upserts every document in a document store.

storeId.label: Document Store ID
storeId.description: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.

items.label: Loader Overrides
items.description: Optional array of per-loader configs to use instead of the saved ones, in the Upsert Document format.

assistantId.label: Assistant ID
assistantId.description: ID of the assistant, from List Assistants.

details.label: Details
details.description: Full assistant settings object; replaces the current one. Must include `name` for CUSTOM.

credential.label: Credential ID
credential.description: For OPENAI and AZURE: ID of the Flowise credential with the OpenAI API key.

flowise_update_chatflow.label: Update Chatflow
flowise_update_chatflow.description: Updates a chatflow. Only the fields you set are changed.

chatflowId.label: Chatflow ID
chatflowId.description: ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.

flowData.label: Flow Data
flowData.description: New flow graph as a JSON string; replaces the whole graph.

isPublic.label: Public
isPublic.description: Whether the chatflow is publicly accessible without an API key.

flowise_update_document_chunk.label: Update Document Chunk
flowise_update_document_chunk.description: Replaces the text and metadata of one chunk.

storeId.label: Document Store ID
storeId.description: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.

loaderId.label: Loader ID
loaderId.description: ID of a document loader inside the store, from the `loaders` array of Get Document Store.

chunkId.label: Chunk ID
chunkId.description: ID of the chunk, from Get Document Chunks.

metadata.label: Metadata
metadata.description: New metadata object of the chunk.

flowise_update_document_store.label: Update Document Store
flowise_update_document_store.description: Renames a document store or changes its description.

storeId.label: Document Store ID
storeId.description: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.

flowise_update_feedback.label: Update Feedback
flowise_update_feedback.description: Changes the rating or comment of a feedback entry.

feedbackId.label: Feedback ID
feedbackId.description: ID of the feedback entry, from List Feedback or Create Feedback.

flowise_update_tool.label: Update Tool
flowise_update_tool.description: Updates a custom tool. Only the fields you set are changed.

toolId.label: Tool ID
toolId.description: ID of the tool, from List Tools.

schema.label: Input Schema
schema.description: New input schema as a JSON string array; replaces the current one.

flowise_update_variable.label: Update Variable
flowise_update_variable.description: Updates a workspace variable. Only the fields you set are changed.

variableId.label: Variable ID
variableId.description: ID of the variable, from List Variables.

type.label: Type
type.description: Static stores the value; runtime reads the server environment variable.

flowise_upsert_document.label: Upsert Document
flowise_upsert_document.description: Loads, splits and upserts a document into a document store.

storeId.label: Document Store ID
storeId.description: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.

docId.label: Loader ID
docId.description: ID of an existing loader in the store to re-run. Leave empty to add a new loader from Loader.

replaceExisting.label: Replace Existing
replaceExisting.description: Replace the existing loader config and chunks instead of merging.

recordManager.label: Record Manager
recordManager.description: Record manager config. Needed for Delete Vector Store Data to remove these chunks later.
